description: List a schedule's upcoming occurrences (shifts) in a date range, each with its date/time, whether the roster is attending that date, and the assigned volunteers. Requires the `read` scope.

from.description: Start of the range: "yyyy-MM-dd" (account timezone) or a full ISO 8601 datetime. Defaults to now.

schedule_id.description: The schedule's numeric id (from list_schedules or get_schedule).

to.description: End of the range, same formats as `from`. Defaults to 90 days from now.

name: get_upcoming_shifts
title: Get upcoming shifts for a schedule
